mutation_semantics.ADD_CANDIDATE_DEPENDENCY: append the internal candidate-signal-boundary digest to the selected evidence candidate_dependency_digests before raw snapshot digest binding
mutation_semantics.DROP_EVIDENCE: remove selected evidence item from the evidence map before any evidence/view/adjudication derived objects are constructed
mutation_semantics.EMPTY_ADJUDICATION: remove all evidence and produce empty identity_receipts and submissions arrays; unseal and label bundle still bind the empty submission set
mutation_semantics.LEAK_SIGNAL: append newline + 'LEAK::<class>=<exact candidate boundary value>' to rendered excerpt of lexicographically first remaining evidence item for each listed class in listed order
mutation_semantics.MUTATE_LABEL_BUNDLE_AFTER_DIGEST: after label_bundle.digest and durability receipt are frozen, replace label_bundle.payload.version with 'synthetic-v2.0.0-mutated' without recomputing digest or receipt
mutation_semantics.REMOVE_RAW_SNAPSHOT_DIGEST: set selected evidence raw_snapshot_digest to null after raw snapshot payload construction
mutation_semantics.SET_CONFLICTING_ASSESSMENTS: set both human labels to ABSTAIN_CONFLICTING_EVIDENCE and set assessments to E1:SUPPORTS_SAME and E2:SUPPORTS_DIFFERENT for each submission
mutation_semantics.SET_LABEL: replace selected submission label before submission digest and signature construction
mutation_semantics.SET_SAMPLE_DURABLE_AT: replace sample manifest durable_at with mutation durable_at before manifest digest and durability receipt construction
mutation_semantics.SET_SAMPLE_ROLE: replace sample_role before sample manifest digest construction
mutation_semantics.SET_SUBJECT_EQUAL: replace target identity subject_id with source identity subject_id before identity receipt/submission construction
mutation_semantics.SET_SUBMISSION_ORIGIN: replace selected submission origin before submission digest/signature construction
mutation_semantics.SET_SUBMISSION_SEQUENCE: replace selected submission sequence_no and submitted_at before submission digest/signature construction
mutation_semantics.SHARE_ORIGIN_ROOT: replace target evidence origin_root_id with source evidence origin_root_id before origin receipt construction

packet_construction_order: copy base vector and exact candidate signal boundary
apply PRE_DERIVATION mutations in listed case order
construct sample manifest payload, digest, and test-only durability receipt
construct internal candidate signal boundary payload and digest
construct evidence raw snapshot bindings and verified-origin test receipts
construct rendered adjudication view and recomputed redaction receipt
construct two test-only identity receipts and sealed submissions unless emptied
construct authoritative unseal receipt from submission digests
construct immutable label bundle payload, digest, and test-only durability receipt
apply POST_BUNDLE_DIGEST mutations in listed case order
compute expected_packet_digest over canonical JSON of the complete expanded packet

validation_invariants_described_not_exec.candidate_disjointness: rendered adjudication view must contain none of the exact candidate signal values
validation_invariants_described_not_exec.candidate_independence: raw evidence candidate_dependency_digests must not contain the internal candidate-signal-boundary digest
validation_invariants_described_not_exec.direction_neutrality: rendered evidence contains no label or per-item direction assessment fields
validation_invariants_described_not_exec.human_independence: exactly two distinct verified human subject_ids for evaluable labels
validation_invariants_described_not_exec.label_bundle_freeze: stored label bundle digest and durability receipt must recompute over the exact current payload
validation_invariants_described_not_exec.origin_independence: at least two decisive evidence items must resolve to distinct verified origin roots; shared roots collapse
validation_invariants_described_not_exec.real_label_gate: all V2 fixtures and keys are synthetic test-only and can never authorize real labels
validation_invariants_described_not_exec.sample_freeze: EVALUATION_RANDOM sample durable_at must be strictly earlier than first_candidate_score_at
validation_invariants_described_not_exec.sealed_ordering: both submission sequence numbers must be less than unseal sequence and peer_label_visible must be false
